entries.en: Similar occurrences followed in[n]succession earlier this spring.

entries.en: Although things have quieted down[n]until recently, several incidents have[n]occurred once again.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Furthermore, new information has come[n]to light about the suspect who suffered[n]sudden mental shutdown...

entries.speaker: Newscaster

entries.speaker: Sojiro

entries.speaker: Advisor

entries.speaker: Advisor
